# QueerPulse

> A quiet, vouched-for network for LGBTQ+ professionals, creatives and
> community in Lisbon, Portugal. No ads, no algorithm. Membership is by
> invitation from an existing member.

QueerPulse runs a public-service surface that anyone may read, and a private
member surface that requires an invitation. Only the public surface is listed
here.

## What is public

- **Resources** (https://queerpulse.com/resources). Practical guides for queer
  life in Lisbon: trans healthcare and name changes, LGBTQ+-affirming
  therapists and paediatricians, sexual health, harm reduction, disability and
  accessibility, ageing, peer support, and a glossary of terms.
- **Safety** (https://queerpulse.com/safety). Crisis and emergency guidance,
  reporting hate crime, legal rights in Portugal, and how to leave a situation
  safely.
- **Local guides** (https://queerpulse.com/local/safe-spaces). Arriving in
  Lisbon, visas, housing, and safe spaces.
- **About** (https://queerpulse.com/about). The manifesto, governance,
  constitution and transparency reporting.
- **Policies** (https://queerpulse.com/policies/privacy). Privacy, terms,
  cookies and community guidelines.

## What is not public

Member profiles, the feed, messages, gatherings and events, communities, the
forum, the job board and the member directory are all private and require an
invitation. Please do not attempt to index or summarise them.

The magazine, cinema catalogue and studio are public to read but are
deliberately excluded from search indexing. They are shared directly and by
word of mouth rather than surfaced through search.

## Usage

Retrieval and citation with a link back to queerpulse.com is welcome. Use for
model training is not permitted. See https://queerpulse.com/robots.txt.

Contact: https://queerpulse.com/about/contact
